messages.content: Are you between 18 and 65 years old? If you’re not sure whether you’re in that range, please tell me your age.

I’m 170 cm tall and weigh 68 kg, so my BMI is about 23.5.
Are you currently receiving medication-based or psychological treatment for a sleep disorder? If yes, please say what treatment it is, how often you receive or use it, and whether it’s current.
No, I’m not receiving medication-based or psychological treatment for a sleep disorder.
Are you willing to follow the study procedures? If you have a concern about a particular procedure, please tell me which one.
Yes, I’m happy to follow all the study procedures.
Do you work night shifts? If you’re unsure, please describe your usual work schedule.
I work daytime hours, so I don’t work night shifts.
No, I don’t use recreational drugs.
No, I’m neither pregnant nor breastfeeding.
